brief: Manitoba Treasury Board Secretariat (Komlodi) in 2020-2021; routine fiscal, capital-planning and office business unrelated to COVID-19 support programs, public health orders or the Charter challenge.

documents.from: Szilveszter Komlodi, ADM Fiscal Management and Capital Planning
documents.subject: Capital asset inventory - year-end count
documents.body: Departments must submit their year-end capital asset counts by March 26. Please use the revised template, which adds a column for asset location codes. Late submissions will delay the fixed asset reconciliation.
documents.why_irrelevant: Year-end capital accounting memo by the deponent two days before affirming; unrelated to support programs.

documents.subject: Budget lock-up room bookings
documents.body:
Hi all,

Please confirm by Thursday which of you need a seat in the budget lock-up room. Laptops will be issued at the door and collected after.

Szilveszter
documents.why_irrelevant: Near miss: same day as a real Bridge Grant announcement; about seating logistics.

documents.letterhead: Treasury Board Secretariat - Capital Review Committee
documents.subject: Minutes of Capital Review Committee
documents.body:
1. Highway maintenance yard roof replacement approved for 2021/22.

2. Courthouse HVAC upgrade deferred pending engineering report.
